starter.dbd06646: I came down from the snow to rest in the warm grass, and now my medal is gone.
starter.86ff3291: It rolled west, towards the round stone. Would you look for it?
starter.1666fe2e: Thank you. Step on the stone and you will see it.
starter.50aac8a2: Then I will wait here. It is warm, at least.
starter.047b2421: The round stone, at the west end of this clearing. Please look there.
starter.de56502c: Something shines beside the round stone. It is the white lion's medal!
starter.5b5de3e9: My medal! You kept your word, Tamer.
starter.5af8aa15: A city that has friends like you must be warm too. I will go and see it.
starter.bdb93f26: The white lion joined the city!
